title: ChipBlocks materials manifest
description: Layer 0 of the 9-layer abstraction hierarchy (per ADR-006). Materials are atomic — they have physical properties but no geometry yet. Geometry comes in Layer 1 (shapes), interfaces in Layer 2, behaviors in Layer 3. Each material's properties carry the full provenance fragment from provenance.schema.json (per ADR-007): value + units + source + conditions + confidence + tolerance + notes. Materials.yaml is the canonical source for material data; community-shipped libraries may add their own materials in separate files.

id.description: Material id used by shapes.yaml + devices.yaml as a FK reference. Allowed: letters (case-sensitive — `FR4`, `Al2O3`, `Sn63Pb37` are canonical industry names), digits, underscore, hyphen. Must start with a letter.

category.description: Broad category. Used by the palette UI for grouping + by validators for sanity checks (e.g., 'a conductor cannot be a capacitor dielectric').

color.description: Hex color or canonical CSS color name.

properties.description: Map of property name to provenance fragment. Property names use snake_case: resistivity, permittivity_relative, permeability_relative, thermal_conductivity, density, melting_point, dielectric_strength, band_gap, etc. Each property's value carries the shared provenance fragment from provenance.schema.json.

notes.description: Freeform material-level notes — usage hints, common alternatives, safety warnings, RoHS considerations, etc.
